title: Two agents in one post, then one agent naming the other

steps.post: @tester-ds @tester-ds2 which of you can read web pages?
@{agent} which of you two can read web pages? Name the other without pinging them.

groundTruth.answer: tester-ds holds web; tester-ds2 does not
groundTruth.spec: §4.5 a post mentioning two agents present starts no turn; the system bot posts a mechanical correction naming the backtick form; a turn addresses at most one colleague

pass: The first post started no turn for either agent and the system bot posted the correction; the second post produced one turn by tester-ds whose reply names tester-ds2 without a mention (backticks or plain text) and states correctly that only tester-ds reads pages.

checks.text: No status post and no reply followed the first post; a system-bot post did, saying to address one agent and how to name one without addressing it.
The second post produced exactly one turn; the reply does not contain @tester-ds2 and no second turn for tester-ds2 started.
The reply's account of who holds web is correct and drawn from the roster in the prompt, not guessed.
